mapper.select: SELECT a.*, IF(b.ID is not null,b.NAME,c.NAME) as objName, d.NAME as objMemo FROM PAN_FILE_PERMISSION a LEFT JOIN SYS_USER b ON a.USER_ID = b.ID left join SYS_ORG c on a.USER_ID = c.ID left join SYS_ORG d on b.ORG_ID = d.ID WHERE a.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and a.USER_ID = #{objId} and a.COMMON_FILE_ID = #{userFileId}

SELECT a.*, IF(b.ID is not null,b.NAME,c.NAME) as objName, d.NAME as objMemo FROM PAN_FILE_PERMISSION a LEFT JOIN SYS_USER b ON a.USER_ID = b.ID left join SYS_ORG c on a.USER_ID = c.ID left join SYS_ORG d on b.ORG_ID = d.ID WHERE a.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and a.COMMON_FILE_ID = #{userFileId}
SELECT distinct a.* FROM PAN_USER_FILE a JOIN PAN_FILE_PERMISSION b ON a.ID = b.COMMON_FILE_ID and b.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' ${ew.customSqlSegment}

SELECT b.*, a.ID as commonId,a.COMMON_FILE_ID as commonFileId,a.FILE_PERMISSION_CODE as filePermissionCode, c.NAME as objName,d.NAME as objMemo FROM PAN_FILE_PERMISSION a JOIN PAN_USER_FILE b ON a.COMMON_FILE_ID = b.ID and b.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' LEFT JOIN SYS_USER c ON b.USER_ID = c.ID left join SYS_ORG d on c.ORG_ID = d.ID ${ew.customSqlSegment}
